observations.behavior: Adds a new private helper function to set a channel star, using Django ORM get_or_create or delete, and a helper to check if a channel is starred.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds backend support for storing a user's star status on a channel, which is used by the channel resolution and star API. This could support a feature where users can mark channels as favorites, potentially improving discoverability or personalization.
